scientific_conclusion: The exact Stage-79 dominant shell is reconstructed from its ten fixed radial nodes and retained angular sectors to machine precision. Global radial node 21 (speed 2.525317 in the frozen velocity rule) carries 30.8178% of the shell-level cell-divergence absolute magnitude and 30.9122% of the face magnitude; the top three nodes together carry 83.8784%. The retained vertical-oblique sectors carry 86.5136% of the shell-level cell-divergence magnitude. Node 21 remains coherent across adjacent x faces (correlation 0.907555) but strongly face-to-cell cancellation dominated (ratio 0.0727825). This is a frozen residual-structure localization only, not an adjoint sensitivity or evidence that modifying quadrature or transport would improve q_av.
positive_findings: The exact Stage-79 shell-2 field is reconstructed from the ten fixed radial nodes and retained angular groups to numerical precision.
Global radial node 21 exceeds the preregistered 20% dominance guard, and the retained vertical-oblique sectors exceed the inherited 70% concentration guard.
No cavity solver rerun or physical/numerical retuning was performed.
negative_findings: Radial-node/angular concentration is not an adjoint sensitivity and is not evidence that changing velocity quadrature or transport will reduce q_av error.
Node 21 is still strongly face-to-cell cancellation dominated despite its within-shell magnitude share.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and is not extended across Knudsen number.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned.
